description: Terminal-Bench style SLO math: reduce a 900-line nginx combined-format access log into the six error-budget numbers (totals, 5xx ratio to 3 decimals, 499 count, 5xx client stats) the gate recomputes line-by-line from the log.

criteria: All six error-budget numbers match the log exactly (5xx ratio with exactly 3 decimals, 499 from the status field, unique and top 5xx clients correct) and the log, the docs and the gate are untouched.
